provenance.l: Beresheet — an IMU fault from ~14 km; the command sent to fix it shut the main engine off and the restart came too late; last telemetry at ~150 m, moving vertically at ~500 km/h; impact 19:23 UTC 11 Apr 2019. No descent timeline found: the model starts at 2.5 km with the engine nearly dry and ends at the last vertical speed (the horizontal motion is not drawn)

Beresheet (docs/wip/2026-11-23-lunar-landings-record.md): an IMU fault from about 14 km; the main engine cut at about 10 km and restarted too late; last telemetry at 149 m: 134 m/s vertical and 947 m/s horizontal (The Planetary Society); no impact speed was published. This profile starts at 2.5 km, so the cut and the late restart are not drawn: the plume is shown going out at 2.4 km (an estimate) and the fall is the recorded impact
